What is Compliance OS™?

Our open-architecture agentic AI platform automates, validates and monitors cyber controls to deliver seamless, secure compliance as code.

When government agencies and enterprises adopt Compliance OS™, they replace the burden of manual evidence collections and episodic audits that analyze the past, with continuous compliance that validates the present and informs the future.

This approach saves organizations time, lowers their costs and reduces their risk, and sets a new standard for ensuring organizations are always mission-ready.

01

Platform Capabilities

The Cav platform optimizes tedious, incomplete, and expensive cyber compliance programs for more than 100+ frameworks, regulations, and mandates with complete traceability.

Continuous Compliance

AI agents continuously collect evidence, identify gaps against any framework, and assist with remediation, keeping you perpetually audit-ready with minimal effort.

Audit Acceleration

Model Context Protocol (MCP) allows for a seamless data collection among AI agents, cloud computing, and external applications.

Continuous Controls Monitoring

Continuously test all of your controls as AI agents plug into corporate data and tools, automating collection, mapping, documentation, and monitoring across frameworks.

Automated Control Mapping

Seamlessly map controls across 100+ compliance frameworks and certifications. Test once, comply many times. Eliminate redundant manual mapping work and instantly expand your compliance coverage with continuous controls mapping across evolving regulatory landscapes.

cATO Certification

Cav accelerates both ATO and continuous ATO through automated control mapping, real-time evidence ingestion, continuous monitoring, and AI-generated artifacts that streamline the most complex processes for faster authorization and secure compliance.
